owner_calls.question: Avengers: Infinity War never shows Xandar: Thanos taking the Power Stone there happens before the film and is only mentioned in dialogue (Thor: "he stole it last week when he decimated Xandar"). Does a dialogue-only, off-screen event count as on screen?
options: Keep the entry (stated in the film's dialogue)
Remove the entry (the event is not shown on screen)
owner_calls.evidence: Thor says Thanos already has the Power Stone because he stole it last week when he decimated Xandar; the film opens on the Statesman with the stone already in Thanos's gauntlet. Xandar itself never appears.
